reviews.text:
My family and I chose DIGS to care for our 5 month old border collie mix Violet while we were on our 10 day vacation and we could not be happier with the care she recieved.

She ended up getting sick and DIGS staff were super communicative with us about her symptoms, and they even brought her to a local vet for us and administered her prescribed medication.

We also got an update and picture each day which really helped us feel at ease, especially since it was our first time leaving her.

We highly recommend DIGS to any family needing a place to board their fur baby while they’re away! DIGS will forever be our go-to boarding facility any time we go away!
Won’t take accountability for their mistakes. Awful experience.

We have been a long term customer with Digs, but recently more often than not I am seeing my dog not get taken care of as he was earlier. Recently, they have not been giving him enough water for long periods of time and once I showed up to hear him crying without being attended to.

Today, I picked him up from grooming and the person at the desk included an 18% tip by default without asking. In the past I have always added more tip for the groomer. She didn’t even share that until I asked her for a receipt and then I called her out only to have it reverted. Please check the itemized charges for grooming always before you leave.
This place is incredible. By far the best in the neighborhood for grooming, daycare (with dropoff/pickup!) and boarding.

Our cocker Sophie had a great stay at Digs.
Great Staff and very clean facility. I definitely recommend boarding your pup there as our Sophie had a great stay and very well taken care of. Will return soon.

This doggy heaven was perfect!!!! Fantastic people it was her first time ever at daycare they pampered her loved her and she went home tired, nails trimmed and with a full belly! They offer many services so my pup could have play and get pretty. I'm a little helicoptery and they have access to cameras so made me feel super comfortable and got pictures and text updates about her stay! We were from Canada and couldn't find anywhere else that we felt comfortable but this one the second I seen it felt good and I was right they are fantastic absolutely 100% recommend especially for travelers!!!! Thank you Digs she had so much fun!

What a disappointing experience.

Booking process: I read reviews from 3 years ago mentioning issues with online booking, and apparently nothing has changed. There's no option to book a meet-and-greet online, so I booked a regular 2-hour daycare appointment through their system.

When I arrived, the receptionists were unfriendly and seemed completely disinterested in dogs or their owners. The selective treatment was immediately noticeable.

I asked if dogs are separated by size or if they all play together. They confirmed all dogs play together and mentioned there was currently a German Shepherd and a Husky in the playroom. My dog is an Italian Greyhound—a fragile breed—and I expressed my concern, explaining that he broke his leg last year. Despite being fully recovered, I'm naturally cautious about him playing with much larger dogs. I received zero empathy or reassurance. Instead, the staff seemed to be searching for reasons to turn me away.

Then the excuses started piling up:
1. They suddenly claimed a meet-and-greet is 4 hours to "better assess" my dog, and that they close at 6pm so there wasn't enough time (it was 4pm). Mind you, I didn't book a meet-and-greet because that option doesn't exist on their website.
2. They called a manager who said they'd make an "exception."
3. Then they claimed they never received my dog's vaccination records through the website, even though I had submitted them. I immediately emailed them (with the receptionist condescendingly spelling out "CONTACT" for me (I mean, WHY?). Once I sent it, they went silent on that issue.
4. Next excuse: it was "feeding schedule" time for the dogs inside, so my dog wouldn't even have time to play. Then they said they USUALLY close at 9pm (not 6pm as they'd said minutes earlier), but because of the snow storm, they were closing at 6pm.

My issue isn't even about the selective treatment I felt I received (which I found in previous reviews here as well).

In fact, I appreciate that they didn't commit to caring for a fragile-breed dog if they're clearly not trained for it.

What bothered me was the constant stream of excuses and dishonesty. It would have been far more respectful to simply say upfront: "Our system made a booking error" OR "Your dog seems like a liability and we can't accommodate him." Instead, they wasted my time with one fabricated reason after another.
They did such a good job with my Pomeranian!

Our baby girl loves DIGS so much and they’re so good to her! They absolutely spoiled her for her birthday and sent me birthday photos. They humor our crazy overprotective dog parenting, and you can just tell they love the dogs. They know her friends, her likes, and her dislikes. And the groomers are incredible too. We’re so lucky to have DIGS in our neighborhood. Our baby comes home smelling incredible too!
They make everything so easy and accommodating! The team is friendly, responsive and professional. Could not be more grateful, and thank you for taking such amazing care of Gunner!
Nancy did a great job with my dog’s grooming! It was our first time going to a new groomer in about 4 years and I couldn’t have been happier with the service!

Love them! The facility is amazing, and the staff has been great (they truly seem to care about the pets unlike other places). And as a practical matter, the hours are soooo much better for the average persons NYC work schedule than really any other place in Brooklyn. If they only closed later on Sundays, all of my pet care problems would be solved :)

My dogs always come back happy and exhausted from DIGS! The employees always greet us with genuine excitement when I drop my dogs off. I know they are being cared for when they are at daycare or boarding. I’ve also had good experiences with the grooming services!
Great day care and grooming services. Still goes back after moved to queens.
Love sending my dog Bear to digs! He has such a great time and is so happy to go in. The grooming services at Digs are also top notch!
My dog stayed two days. She received boarding, walks and bath. She was well cared for and very happy!
My dog always loves coming to daycare here, and I enjoy his nap that follows. Highly recommended.

Our 6 month old pup has separation anxiety and we've been working up slowly to him being left alone. Tried another daycare who blatantly lied to us and we could see how stressed he was and how much he hated it, but they kept saying how much he loved it.

Explained the situation to Digs staff and we always received 100% honesty, even telling us to come pick him up one day if we wanted because he was extremely stressed/overwhelmed  and having issues. Fast forward to today where he was able to by there for 6 hours and loved it. This is all because they worked with us to build up his confidence and trust by being truthful with us to manage the situation.

We will continue to use Digs, and also had him groomed there a few weeks back which went perfectly too. Can't recommend enough!

I recently took my dog to DIGS,  and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Nancy, the groomer did an exceptional job as always! My dog’s haircut is perfect , she looks adorable, and I can tell she feels great too. I highly recommend Nancy she’s kind, professional and clearly very skilled. I really appreciate the care she give to my dog I will not choose anywhere else besides DIGS!

DIG’s is where it’s at. Amazing service. Phenomenal communication. There’s not a lot of business’s that communicate with the customer anymore. DIG’s goes above and beyond. We’ve done daycare and grooming. Both services are 5 Star

They were very professional. Establishment is clean, well kept and organized. We went for our assessment to see if my dog could go there however we agreed with his level of anxiety and attachment to me he could affect the behavior of the other dogs there. So it was suggested for me to go to a special trainer first then definitely come back to them. Which is pretty cool. Other places usually just don’t give him benefit of the doubt like he’s a lost cause or something. They at least told me to come back after. So I would recommend this place they showed patience with my dog other places didn’t.

If you’re looking to send your dog for daycare or boarding, stop looking and book your stay at Digs. Selecting a doggy daycare is hard because we all love our pets but rest assured - this is genuinely the best facility out there. We send Theo, our one year old golden doodle for extended boarding stays (2 weeks+) at a time so we are very familiar with Digs - let me tell you more:

In selecting a place for Theo for his daycare and boarding, we were anxious and did ALL the research in selecting the best facility we could find. We decided on Digs for three reasons: staff, cleanliness, and quality of care for the dogs. From daily report cards that recount your dog’s stay, to the extraordinary staff that keeps you updated without you even asking (eg. is Theo eating properly?) Digs is truly the standard in doggy day cares and boarding. They take the initiative in proactively ensuring your dog is eating and sleeping well - and enjoying their time. I’ve never had to chase for an update. They are proactive - for example, they have messaged me asking what they can do to help Theo eat better as he is a picky eater; they text me photos of him playing; they have done all of this on their own accord because they genuinely care and it shows - they truly are an amazing staff.

Digs is also meticulously clean - whenever we go, someone is always cleaning and it is evident by the way the facility looks and smells: clean and immaculate. This was a huge factor as well and we have been beyond happy with their cleanliness standards and our dog not catching anything. Because of their rigor in this matter, we have never had an issue as it’s so clean and well kept. Lastly, Digs also has cameras that live stream daycare so you can clock in anytime - this has been amazing as we can watch Theo play and hangout.

And honestly, I can’t say enough good things about the staff. They have truly have taken care of Theo as their own. They are always, ALWAYS kind, professional, and incredibly caring. They are super prompt in their responses and will always respond with a solution - and with a smile. Theo absolutely loves his time at Digs.

We could not be happier with choosing Digs - the staff sets the standard in professionalism, being kind, and in doggy daycare and boarding. The pictures say it all!
Nancy always does an amazing job with our Samoyed and we bring her here because nowhere else does she get deshedded so well. Our girl is ready for summer:)

I have a 65lb+ pittie who is a gentle giant but finding boarding for him can be a challenge because of his breed. DIGS has always made me and my pup welcome, cared for, and always very communicative. Its such a relief to be able to leave my pittie with people who enjoy his company and who care about all the dogs there. 5 stars from me and my pittie!
all around great communication skills, very gentle and caring with the dogs, great environmental space for the pets, safely and healthy provides what’s needed for your dog/s!!!

We have been bringing our large dogs here for a few years, they have always taken really good care and our dogs love it here. They keep the place clean so our dogs never catch germs and get sick there (which has happened frequently at some other places), and they pay attention and are very communicative whenever they see a potential health issue. When we board our dogs here they send photos and updates, and communicate and spend extra time making sure both of them are eating their food (one of them sometimes skips meals even at home). The groomers also do a great job taking care of matting issues and they look very cute after their baths & haircuts.

It was Moon’s first haircut and grooming ever and we were so nervous. But she was in great hands with Jim! She still looks like herself but better, which is what we wanted. We are so happy with the result and the service was great too. We will be back soon and excited to try DIGS other offerings. Thank you Jim and DIGS!
We definitely come back! The grooming service by Jim & Nancy is fantastic. The staffs are friendly. Her fur becomes very soft and smooth also smell so good she’s got 1000x kisses after 😂. …

I absolutely LOVED this place! All staff were super informative and friendly. He did an amazing job with our furry baby. This place is super friendly, caring and overall 5 stars! I highly recommend it. Thank you guys again from her mom, dad and Sadie!!!
They always take great care of my dog when I leave him here for daycare! Love that they have such long hours which makes it super convenient when I go into the office and come back late!
Clean facility! Naj and Timothy are very helpful receptionists. Can’t wait to visit again soon🐶 thank you! …
always the best. my dog Radio loves loves loves to spend his Fridays at DIGS. the staff is always welcoming to him and responsive to me. very clean and always professional.

Digs is great! It warms my heart to see PJ run towards daycare and get excited to see the staff behind the desk. If she can't be with me, I want her to be somewhere she wants to be - and she wants to be at Digs!

I LOVE Digs. My dog Chance typically never liked daycare and always cried when I dropped him off to other places, so I was very nervous the first time bringing him in. He’s been consistently coming for over a year now and I always SO excited— dragging me inside excited to see the staff and other dogs. The grooming is also amazing. And to speak on the staff— they are all outstanding and have stayed late for me if I’m running behind at work to pick him up. I truly appreciate Digs and the entire team!

My dog Judy and I have been loving Digs for almost a year now. I appreciate how organized and on top of things they are, which I have not seen with some daycares in Brooklyn, and I love that they will text me updates about her just to keep me in the loop (like if she’s having runny stool, which she sometimes has when I’m away from her). Judy also has a lot of separation anxiety at night and can take a while to calm down in her room when she’s boarding, but they always shower her with love and make sure she gets comfortable and falls asleep. I also love the daily report cards when she’s boarding! Judy always comes home and immediately knocks out from all the playing. Thanks, Digs!

I am taking my cavapoo to this place for daycare. Thankfully I only committed to 10 sessions, because he is on his 5th one and I can’t be any more unsatisfied.
One the days when I picked him up, I ask if he has finished his diner and they said yes and gave me back an empty container. Obviously I didn’t feed him when we got back home and next morning he was throwing up a yellow liquid, which happens when he doesn’t eat. Another day I picked him up and he was extremely thirsty, unfortunately I didn’t have his bottle in my car and when we got back home, he went straight to his water bowl and drank all the water ( which tell me he is not getting enough water there ) and the last one that made me write this review is from today. He is 4 days late on his vaccine and because of that they have him in solitary in a room. I paid for him to socialize, not to be in a room by himself.
I probably going to finish the sessions that i paid for because I don’t want to argue with them about a refund and I don’t want to loose my money, but definitely looking for another place.

We take our dog here for grooming and Nancy is great! He gets scared but she’s really good with him and will show us videos and photos of how he did. He always leaves happy and Nancy always makes sure to ask if we have any special requests for his grooming. Definitely recommend!
The grooming service was great! They took really good care of my dog, and she came back super happy.

This is the best place to take your fur children to if you’re looking for boarding, or any of their featured services that you’re interested in! I’ve had such a hard time finding a place for my dog because he’s considered a senior dog. However, DIGS Canine Hotel Spa & Daycare came in clutch! As long as you know that your pet is workable and passes their assessment, I guarantee you that DIGS Canine Hotel Spa and Daycare will take absolute care of your pet! I was gone for about a week, and I was nervous about leaving my dog for so long because he’s never been in any long periods of boarding, but DIGS created the perfect environment for him, and he was able to enjoy his stay, made friends, and had a great time! I went with the Orion Luxury Suite package, which was worth the spending ! I’m forever grateful to find about DIGS and their services, and I’m absolutely looking forward to doing more business with them. Special thanks to Zanola, Lily, X, Claire, Camila, and all that were able to spend time with him to take care of him. Once again, I’m grateful to you all! May you all continue to have successful business and more to come!
Great experience with my puppy’s first groom with Nancy. Our puppy was happy and relaxed when we picked her up.
I love Digs canine grooming. I have been there with 3 dogs it was amazing they smell so goods and have shinny furs . Definitely I will be there again
We love coming to Digs for a bath and daycare! The staff is very friendly and accommodating. Our doodle had a few mats and they didn’t charge us extra like most places could.

We absolutely love Digs Hotel! The team is incredibly attentive and caring, always keeping us updated and checking in regularly, which provides such peace of mind. The staff truly goes above and beyond in taking the best care of our furry family member. This is our 4th year with Digs, and we trust their entire team and groomer Nancy completely. They have been nothing short of amazing, and we’re so grateful for the love and care they give Sook. Highly recommend!

Always a great experience boarding with DIGS. Our pup has a bit of separation anxiety when we travel so it is a relief to find a place we know she is in good hands. We appreciate the report cards, web cams, and great communication with their staff. Highly recommend for boarding and daycare.
Really lovely and caring staff. Love the hours that helps accommodate my crazy work schedule!

DIGS Reviews

I was very disappointed with my experience with DIGS. My dog was injured under their care, resulting in $10,000+ in veterinary / surgeon expenses and a 6+ month recovery timeline.

Management was not cooperative with discussing a plan to cover any of the costs, instead passing me along to an insurance agent who took weeks to conclude that employee negligence was not covered under their policy.

I understand that this is a risk of bringing your dog to a daycare, however, one can infer that a dislocated hip to an otherwise healthy / active dog was the result of something more than a “playground” scuffle that could have been prevented if the staff had been keeping better watch / was trained in deescalation tactics.

While the treatment costs are onerous, I’m more disappointed that I trusted DIGS to take care of my pet.

For those thinking this was an isolated incident, my vet was quick to tell me they have had many patients with similar injuries / scares from DIGS. I hope the staff has taken steps to improve their safety protocols and training. However, recommend looking elsewhere for dog care needs in the neighborhood.
